The '''Twilight Gardens''' referred to [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] hunting grounds in the [[wroshyr]] jungles of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and his son [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawaroo]] traveled through there.<ref name="Tyrant's Test" />
